title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: For tomorrow's switch to a fresh session each day: in the Claude app, open Scheduled in the sidebar, open "LEDGER: the day's fresh session" and set its permission mode to Auto (not Bypass), then save. The app would not let the session set it: your message came from another device. Without it the 05:21 session stops at its first file write until you approve it.
sections.recommendation: Auto, as this session runs now; it is not bypassing permissions. Optional: in the waiting session "LEDGER: the day's fresh session, test (once)", allow its one file write so tonight's test finishes. No web link: the setting is in the app.
